entrances.name: 42nd Street and Seventh Avenue
entrances.note: From the street, go down to the upper mezzanine, then down again to the 1, 2, and 3. The southeast elevator is the step-free way.

entrances.name: Broadway plaza between 42nd and 43rd
entrances.note: The elevator here drops toward the shuttle. Grand Central is east. The 1, 2, and 3 are toward Seventh Avenue, not this plaza.

entrances.name: 40th Street and Seventh Avenue
entrances.note: Signed for the 1, 2, 3, 7, and S. Stairs go down to a mezzanine above the 1, 2, and 3 platforms.

entrances.name: 40th Street and Broadway
entrances.note: Signed for the N, Q, R, W, and S. This entrance does not open onto the 1, 2, and 3.

uptown-123.approach: From the upper mezzanine, go down the stairs. The uptown signs are on the platform after those stairs, and they face north toward the Bronx.

downtown-123.approach: From the upper mezzanine, go down the stairs. The downtown signs are on the platform after those stairs, and they face south toward Brooklyn.

seven-stairs.level: 7 platform, the deepest level under 41st Street
seven-stairs.approach: On the 1, 2, 3 platform, stairs go down again. The 7 signs are after those stairs. Queens is east.

seven-elevator.level: 7 platform, the deepest level under 41st Street
seven-elevator.approach: Skip the 7 stairs. Use the elevator on the southeast corner of 42nd Street and Seventh Avenue. Queens is east.

broadway-plaza-elevator.approach: The shuttle signs are by the Broadway plaza elevator, above the 1, 2, 3. Grand Central is east.

elevators.se42and7: Elevator on the southeast corner of 42nd Street and 7th Avenue. It is in service for this demo.
elevators.broadwayPlaza: Elevator on the Broadway plaza between 42nd and 43rd Streets. It is in service for this demo.

nodes.name: Uptown 1/2/3
nodes.follow: Follow this sign. This is the uptown 1, 2, or 3 toward the Bronx.
nodes.reject: Turn around. This is the uptown train toward the Bronx.

turns.straight: You are facing the uptown 1, 2, or 3.
turns.behind: The uptown sign is behind you. Turn around.
turns.left: Turn left until the uptown sign is in front of you.
turns.right: Turn right until the uptown sign is in front of you.

nodes.name: Downtown 1/2/3
nodes.follow: Follow this sign. This is the downtown 1, 2, or 3 toward Brooklyn.
nodes.reject: Turn around. This is the downtown train toward Brooklyn.

turns.straight: Keep the downtown sign in front of you.
turns.behind: The downtown train is behind you. Turn around.
turns.left: Turn left until you face the downtown sign.
turns.right: Turn right until you face the downtown sign.

nodes.name: 7 train stairs
nodes.level: 7 platform, the deepest level under 41st Street
nodes.follow: These stairs go toward the 7. Follow them only if you can use stairs.
nodes.accessibleInstruction: Do not follow these stairs. Use the elevator on the southeast corner of 42nd Street and 7th Avenue for a step-free way toward the 7.

turns.straight: The 7 stair sign is ahead. If you need an elevator, do not go down it.
turns.behind: The 7 stair sign is behind you.
turns.left: Turn left to face the 7 sign again.
turns.right: Turn right to face the 7 sign again.

nodes.name: Elevator toward the 7
nodes.level: 7 platform, the deepest level under 41st Street
nodes.follow: Use the elevator on the southeast corner of 42nd Street and 7th Avenue. It is the step-free way toward the 7.
nodes.reject: This elevator is not the way for the train you want.

turns.straight: Continue toward the elevator on the southeast corner of 42nd Street and 7th Avenue.
turns.behind: The elevator entrance is behind you.
turns.left: Turn left and look for the elevator on the southeast corner of 42nd and 7th.
turns.right: Turn right and look for the elevator on the southeast corner of 42nd and 7th.

nodes.name: Broadway plaza elevator
nodes.follow: This is the elevator on the Broadway plaza between 42nd and 43rd Streets.
nodes.reject: The Broadway plaza elevator is not your next step.

turns.straight: The Broadway plaza elevator is the way you are facing.
turns.behind: The Broadway plaza elevator is behind you.
turns.left: Turn left toward the Broadway plaza elevator.
turns.right: Turn right toward the Broadway plaza elevator.

nodes.name: 42nd Street and Seventh Avenue
nodes.follow: You are at 42nd Street and Seventh Avenue.
nodes.reject: This entrance is not your next step.

nodes.name: Upper mezzanine
nodes.follow: You are on the upper mezzanine under 42nd Street.
nodes.reject: This mezzanine is not your next step.

nodes.name: 40th Street and Seventh Avenue
nodes.follow: This entrance is signed for the 1, 2, 3, 7, and S.
nodes.reject: This entrance is not your next step.

nodes.name: 40th Street and Broadway
nodes.follow: This entrance is the N, Q, R, W, and S side, not the 1, 2, and 3 side.
nodes.reject: This entrance is not your next step.

nodes.name: Broadway plaza between 42nd and 43rd
nodes.follow: You are at the Broadway plaza. The shuttle elevator is here. Grand Central is east.
nodes.reject: This entrance is not your next step.

nodes.name: Lower mezzanine
nodes.follow: You are on the lower mezzanine, above the 7.
nodes.reject: This mezzanine is not your next step.

trips.title: Downtown 1, 2, or 3 toward Brooklyn
trips.summary: Ride the downtown 1, 2, or 3. A correct sign says Downtown or Brooklyn. An uptown or Bronx sign is the wrong side.

trips.title: Uptown 1, 2, or 3 toward the Bronx
trips.summary: Ride the uptown 1, 2, or 3. A correct sign says Uptown or the Bronx. A downtown or Brooklyn sign is the wrong side.

trips.title: 7 toward Queens
trips.summary: The 7 toward Queens sits deeper in the station. Stairs are marked. The step-free way is the elevator on the southeast corner of 42nd Street and 7th Avenue.

trips.title: Shuttle toward Grand Central
trips.summary: The 42nd Street shuttle runs between Times Square and Grand Central. Start from the Broadway plaza elevator if you need a step-free entrance.

trips.title: Step-free entrance, then downtown 1, 2, or 3
trips.summary: Enter at the elevator on the southeast corner of 42nd Street and 7th Avenue, or the elevator on the Broadway plaza between 42nd and 43rd Streets. Then follow a Downtown and Brooklyn sign.
